Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta (CHEMBL262). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target CHEMBL262. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID and return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
